name: Ena
notes: Deep trust and cooperation. She handles healing; he handles movement and protection.

name: Kiri
notes: Protective, but allows her freedom more than he admits. Knows she wanders too far sometimes.

name: Doran
notes: Practical working relationship involving manure, animals, and grazing land coordination.

name: Bran
notes: Occasional cooperation on forest boundaries, with underlying tension about encroachment zones.

name: Ikan
notes: Quiet respect. Finds his curiosity dangerous but understandable.

name: Noki
notes: Sees him as 'unfinished,' but not hopeless.

name: Sena
notes: Respects her listening skills and occasionally shares herd stories with her.
